title: Cardiac Arrest the BC Way, Shocks, Pumps and Pills

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already run CPR at 30:2, use the AED and bag with a BVM. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Run high-quality CPR the BC way; see where EMR and PCP are identical
  2. Understand what your ALS partner adds: drugs, shocks, pacing
  3. Apply BC rules on stopping, moving, hypothermia; spot pumps and pills

Textbook: Chapter 30, PDF pages 2737–2800
slides.say: Welcome to the last lesson of Chapter thirty. You already know CPR and the AED well, and here's good news: in the BC cardiac arrest guideline, almost everything is the same for EMRs and PCPs. So today is about doing the basics at a higher standard, and understanding the team around you. We'll cover three things. First, high-quality CPR and the AED, the BC way. Second, what your advanced care partner adds, like drugs, manual shocks and pacing. Third, BC's rules for stopping, moving and hypothermic arrest, plus the heart pumps and heart pills you'll find on your patients.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎来到第三十章的最后一课。心肺复苏和 AED 你们已经很熟了，好消息是：在 BC 心脏骤停指南里，EMR 和 PCP 几乎所有内容都一样。所以今天是把基本功做到更高标准，并了解你身边的整个团队。今天讲三件事。第一，按 BC 方式做高质量心肺复苏和使用 AED。第二，你的高级生命支持搭档会多做什么，比如用药、手动电击和起搏。第三，BC 关于停止复苏、转运和低体温骤停的规定，以及你会在病人身上看到的心脏泵和心脏药。

slides.title: High-quality CPR, the BC way
slides.body:
Good CPR + early shocks = what saves lives

  • 100–120 a minute, 5–6 cm deep, full recoil
  • 30:2 for adults, with one or two rescuers
  • Pauses in compressions under 5 seconds
  • Keep compressing while the defibrillator charges
  • Swap compressors every 2 minutes; avoid hyperventilation
slides.say: The book is clear: good CPR and a short time to defibrillation matter most for survival. Advanced drugs and procedures probably add very little on top, so watching CPR quality is a key job on scene. BC sets the standard: one hundred to one hundred twenty compressions a minute, five to six centimetres deep, with full recoil. Adults get thirty to two, with one or two rescuers. Keep every pause under five seconds, and keep compressing while the defibrillator charges. Swap compressors every two minutes. And avoid hyperventilation: squeeze just to chest rise, because too much ventilation lowers the heart's output.
slides.sayZh: 书里说得很清楚：高质量心肺复苏和尽快除颤对存活最重要。高级药物和操作在此之上大概只多一点点好处，所以盯住按压质量是现场的关键工作。BC 定了标准：每分钟一百到一百二十次，深五到六厘米，完全回弹。成人按压通气比三十比二，一人或两人施救都一样。每次中断都要少于五秒，除颤仪充电时继续按压。每两分钟换人按压。避免过度通气：捏到看见胸廓起伏就够，因为通气过多会降低心输出量。

slides.title: The AED loop: shock or no shock
slides.body:
Breathing + pulse, ≤ 10 s→CPR 30:2→AED analyzes
Shock advisedVF or pulseless VTshock → 2 min CPR → analyze
No shock advisedasystole or PEA2 min CPR → analyze
  • Pulse check with each analysis, and at any sign of ROSC
  • Peel off nitro patches; no pad over a pacemaker bulge
slides.say: Here's the BC loop, the same for every licence level. Check breathing and the pulse together, for no more than ten seconds. No pulse, or only gasping, means cardiac arrest: start CPR and apply the AED as soon as possible. If a shock is advised, the rhythm is VF or pulseless VT: shock, then two minutes of CPR, then analyze again. If no shock is advised, it's asystole or PEA: two minutes of CPR, then analyze. Check the pulse during each analysis, and whenever you see signs of ROSC, like breathing, coughing or movement. Peel off any nitro patch first, and don't put a pad over a pacemaker bulge.
slides.sayZh: 这是 BC 的流程，所有执照级别都一样。同时检查呼吸和脉搏，不超过十秒。没有脉搏或只有濒死喘息，就是心脏骤停：开始心肺复苏，尽快接上 AED。提示电击，说明是室颤或无脉室速：电击，然后做两分钟心肺复苏，再分析。提示不电击，就是心搏停止或 PEA：做两分钟心肺复苏，再分析。每次分析时查脉搏，看到自主循环恢复的迹象，比如呼吸、咳嗽或活动，也要查。先撕掉硝酸甘油贴片，电极片不要贴在起搏器鼓包上。

slides.title: What your ALS partner adds
slides.body:
• Manual shocks: 200 J biphasic, 360 J monophasic, if unsure
  • IV or IO; epinephrine 1 mg IV every 3–5 minutes
  • Amiodarone or lidocaine if VF persists after the 3rd shock
  • Intubation can wait 8+ min; SGA + waveform ETCO₂ work well
  • ETCO₂ falling: tired compressor? Sudden rise: ROSC?
  • After ROSC: SpO₂ 94–98%, systolic over 90, early 12-lead
slides.say: What does your advanced care partner add, according to the book? Manual shocks, at two hundred joules on a biphasic machine if the maker's setting is unknown. An IV or intraosseous line, then epinephrine, one milligram IV every three to five minutes: after the second shock in VF, or as soon as possible in PEA and asystole. Amiodarone or lidocaine if VF lasts past the third shock. Intubation can wait. Waveform ETCO2, the carbon dioxide breathed out, tracks CPR quality: a falling number may mean a tired compressor, and a sudden rise may mean ROSC. Your part: keep compressions going through all of it.
slides.sayZh: 按书里的说法，你的高级生命支持搭档会多做什么？手动电击，不清楚厂家设定时，双相除颤仪用两百焦。建立静脉或骨髓腔通路，然后给肾上腺素，每三到五分钟静脉一毫克：室颤在第二次电击后给，PEA 和心搏停止则尽早给。第三次电击后仍是室颤，用胺碘酮或利多卡因。气管插管可以等。呼气末二氧化碳波形图能反映按压质量：数值下降可能是按压者累了，突然升高可能是自主循环恢复。你的部分是：这一切进行时，按压不能停。

slides.q: You and one partner are doing CPR on an adult, with no advanced airway. The book allows continuous compressions with 8–10 breaths a minute. What does BC expect?
options: Continuous compressions with 8–10 breaths a minute
30:2, with pauses up to 10 seconds per rhythm check
slides.say: Quiz time. You and one partner are doing CPR on an adult, with no advanced airway. The book allows continuous compressions with eight to ten breaths a minute. What does BC expect? A, continuous compressions with eight to ten breaths a minute. B, thirty to two, with pauses under five seconds. C, fifteen to two, because there are two rescuers. D, thirty to two, with pauses up to ten seconds per rhythm check. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 小测验。你和一位搭档在给成人做心肺复苏，还没有高级气道。书里允许持续按压加每分钟八到十次通气。BC 要求什么？A 持续按压加每分钟八到十次通气；B 三十比二，中断少于五秒；C 十五比二，因为有两名施救者；D 三十比二，每次节律检查可中断最多十秒。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. For adults, BC uses thirty to two with one or two rescuers, and keeps every pause in compressions under five seconds, for EMRs and PCPs alike. A is the book's two-rescuer option, not the BC rule. C is BC's two-rescuer ratio for a child or infant, not an adult. D uses the book's ten-second limit; BC asks for less than five.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。成人在 BC 一律三十比二，一人或两人都一样，每次按压中断少于五秒，EMR 和 PCP 相同。A 是书里双人施救的选项，不是 BC 规定。C 是 BC 对儿童和婴儿双人施救的比例，不是成人。D 用的是书里的十秒上限，BC 要求少于五秒。

slides.title: The reversible causes
slides.body:
H'sT's
HypoxiaTension pneumothorax
HypovolemiaTamponade, cardiac
Hydrogen ion (acidosis)Toxins (incl. anaphylaxis)
Hypo/hyperkalemiaThrombosis, pulmonary
HypothermiaThrombosis, coronary
  • BC: an apparent reversible cause → transport can be considered
slides.say: BC lists the treatable causes of cardiac arrest, often called the H's and T's. Hypoxia, hypovolemia, hydrogen ions, meaning acidosis, low or high potassium, and hypothermia. Then tension pneumothorax, cardiac tamponade, toxins including anaphylaxis, and a clot in the lungs or in a coronary artery. Why do they matter to you? BC says that if there's an apparent reversible cause, transport can be considered, and the decision rests on the history and your exam. So look for clues: an airway problem suggests hypoxia, recent surgery or a long trip suggests a lung clot, and chest pain before the collapse suggests a coronary cause.
slides.sayZh: BC 列出了心脏骤停的可治疗病因，常叫做 H 和 T。缺氧、低血容量、氢离子即酸中毒、低钾或高钾、低体温；然后是张力性气胸、心包填塞、毒物（包括过敏性休克）、肺动脉或冠状动脉里的血栓。为什么跟你有关？BC 规定：如果有明显的可逆病因，可以考虑转运，而这个决定取决于病史和你的检查。所以要找线索：气道问题提示缺氧，近期手术或长途旅行提示肺栓塞，倒下前有胸痛提示冠脉原因。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: adult cardiac arrest in BC
slides.body:
BC Adult CPR/AED, CPR basic concepts, treatable causes, PEEP guideline

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • CPR 30:2; 100–120/min; 5–6 cm
  • Pauses under 5 s; swap every 2 min
  • AED as soon as possible; CPR while charging
  • Consider reversible causes and transport
  • Same 30 / 40-minute time points
  • Consult medical oversight to stop on scene

PCP adds

  • SGA insertion once high-quality CPR is under way
  • PEEP valve on the BVM? Remove it in cardiac arrest

Everything else is identical for EMR and PCP.
slides.say: Here's the clearest EMR versus PCP picture in the chapter. Every licence level does CPR at thirty to two, one hundred to one hundred twenty a minute, five to six centimetres deep, with pauses under five seconds and a new compressor every two minutes. Everyone applies the AED early, considers reversible causes, uses the same thirty and forty minute time points, and consults medical oversight before stopping on scene. The PCP column is short: the BC guideline mentions supraglottic airway insertion by PCPs once high-quality CPR is under way. And if you're bagging with a PEEP valve, remove it when the patient arrests.
slides.sayZh: 这是本章最清楚的 EMR 与 PCP 对照。每个执照级别都做三十比二的心肺复苏，每分钟一百到一百二十次，深五到六厘米，中断少于五秒，每两分钟换人。每个人都尽早用 AED，考虑可逆病因，用同样的三十分钟和四十分钟时间点，现场停止复苏前都要咨询医疗监督。PCP 这一栏很短：BC 指南提到，高质量心肺复苏开始后，PCP 可以置入声门上气道。还有，如果你在用带 PEEP 阀的 BVM 通气，病人一旦心脏骤停就要把 PEEP 阀拿掉。

slides.title: When to stop, when to move
slides.body:
BC: keep going until…
Care is handed to more advanced providers
Signs of life: movement, coughing, breathing
30 min: no ROSC and no shocks
40 min: any ROSC or any shock
  • Stopping on scene: consult medical oversight
  • Don't start with a verifiable DNR or No CPR order
  • CPR works better when you're not moving
  • Transport with CPR: children, hypothermia, trauma, treatable causes
slides.say: When do you stop? BC's rule is the same for EMRs and PCPs. Keep going until care is handed to more advanced providers, or there are signs of life such as movement, coughing or breathing. Otherwise, the time point is thirty minutes if there's been no ROSC and no shock, or forty minutes if there was ROSC at any time or any shock. To stop on scene, consult medical oversight. Don't start for a verifiable DNR or no-CPR order. CPR works better when you're not moving, but BC allows transport with ongoing CPR for children, hypothermia, trauma or treatable causes.
slides.sayZh: 什么时候停？BC 的规定对 EMR 和 PCP 一样。一直做到把病人交给更高级的人员，或者出现生命迹象，比如活动、咳嗽或呼吸。否则，时间点是：从没有自主循环恢复、也从没电击过，三十分钟；任何时候有过自主循环恢复或电击过，四十分钟。要在现场停止，须咨询医疗监督。有可核实的不复苏或不做心肺复苏医嘱，就不要开始。不移动时心肺复苏效果更好，但 BC 允许以下情况边按压边转运：儿童、低体温、创伤，或可治疗的病因。

slides.title: Hypothermic arrest
slides.body:
• Feel for a pulse for up to 30–45 seconds
  • AED: up to 3 shocks if indicated
  • After 3 shocks: no more pauses to analyze or shock
  • Continue CPR and rapid transport; remove wet clothing
  • Below 28 °C: don't actively rewarm; insulate, handle gently

Book: its ETCO₂ futility sign and ALS stopping rule don't apply to hypothermia.
slides.say: Hypothermia is the big exception, and BC gives its own steps for every licence level. A very cold patient's pulse can be slow and hard to find, so take up to thirty to forty-five seconds to confirm there's no pulse. In cardiac arrest, use the AED and shock up to three times if advised. After three shocks, don't pause CPR to analyze or shock again; keep compressing and transport rapidly. Remove wet clothing. Below twenty-eight degrees, don't actively rewarm: insulate the patient, heat the ambulance to thirty degrees, and handle them gently. The book agrees it's special: its futility signs don't apply to hypothermia.
slides.sayZh: 低体温是最大的例外，BC 给所有执照级别定了专门步骤。体温很低的病人脉搏可能又慢又难摸，所以要用最多三十到四十五秒确认没有脉搏。心脏骤停时用 AED，提示电击就最多电击三次。三次之后，不再为分析或电击而中断按压，继续按压并快速转运。脱掉湿衣服。低于二十八度时不要主动复温：给病人保温隔热，把救护车加热到三十度，动作要轻柔。书里也认为它特殊：书中判断复苏无效的指标不适用于低体温。

slides.title: Slow or fast, with a pulse
slides.body:
First ask: is the rhythm the cause, or the result of hypoxia, blood loss, cold or a toxin?

PatientBook's ALS treatment
Fast, unstableSynchronized cardioversion
Slow, unstableAtropine, then pacing at 60–80
Stable, regular, narrow, fastVagal manoeuvres first
Other stable patientsMonitor and transport

Unstable = low BP, altered mental status, ischemic chest pain, acute heart failure.
slides.say: Now patients with a pulse and a rate that's too slow or too fast. First ask: is the rhythm the cause, or the result? Hypoxia, blood loss, cold and toxins all change the rate, and treating the rhythm won't fix them. Then ask: is the patient unstable, with low blood pressure, altered mental status, ischemic chest pain or acute heart failure? In the book, unstable fast rhythms get synchronized cardioversion, a shock timed to the R wave. Unstable slow rhythms get atropine, then pacing at sixty to eighty. A stable, regular, narrow fast rhythm gets vagal manoeuvres first, and most other stable patients are monitored and transported.
slides.sayZh: 现在讲有脉搏、但心率太慢或太快的病人。先问：节律是原因，还是结果？缺氧、失血、低体温和毒物都会改变心率，治节律治不了这些。再问：病人不稳定吗？也就是低血压、意识改变、缺血性胸痛或急性心衰。书里，不稳定的快心律用同步电复律，就是对准 R 波放电。不稳定的慢心律先用阿托品，再以每分钟六十到八十次起搏。稳定的、规则的窄 QRS 快心律先试迷走神经手法，其他稳定的病人多数监护并转运即可。

slides.q: Unwitnessed adult arrest. The AED gave one shock early on; no ROSC since. You've reached 30 minutes. What does the BC guideline say?
options: Continue: after any shock, the BC time point is 40 minutes
Stop once you've given three rounds of epinephrine IM
slides.say: Here's a BC decision. An unwitnessed adult cardiac arrest. The AED gave one shock early on, and there's been no ROSC since. You've reached thirty minutes. What does the BC guideline say? A, stop now: thirty minutes without ROSC. B, continue: after any shock, the BC time point is forty minutes. C, continue until sixty minutes, whatever happened. D, stop once you've given three rounds of epinephrine IM. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来做一个 BC 决定。一位无人目击的成人心脏骤停，AED 早期电击过一次，之后一直没有自主循环恢复。现在到了三十分钟。BC 指南怎么说？A 现在停止，已经三十分钟没有自主循环恢复；B 继续，电击过的话 BC 的时间点是四十分钟；C 无论如何做到六十分钟；D 给过三轮肌注肾上腺素后停止。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. BC's thirty-minute point applies only when there has been no ROSC and no defibrillation. One shock moves it to forty minutes, and stopping on scene means consulting medical oversight. A forgets the shock. C isn't a BC rule. D is wrong because epinephrine in BC is IM only, for anaphylaxis and severe bronchospasm; it isn't a cardiac arrest drug for EMRs or PCPs.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。BC 的三十分钟时间点只适用于从没有自主循环恢复、也从没除颤的情况。电击过一次，时间点就变成四十分钟，而且要在现场停止须咨询医疗监督。A 忘了那次电击；C 不是 BC 规定；D 错在 BC 的肾上腺素只能肌注，用于过敏性休克和严重支气管痉挛，不是 EMR 或 PCP 的心脏骤停用药。

slides.title: Heart pumps: ECLS, IABP, LVAD
slides.body:
ECLSoxygenates blood outside the bodybuys time in arrest
IABPballoon in the aortainflates between beats
Impellapumps LV → aortaup to 5 L/min
  • LVAD: continuous flow, so often no pulse, no cuff BP
  • Listen for the hum; judge perfusion; MAP by Doppler
  • Risks: clots, driveline infection, power failure, bleeding
  • Call the 24/7 line; no hum → connect power
  • No hum, no MAP, no circulation → compressions
slides.say: More patients now live with machines that move their blood. ECLS, extracorporeal life support, oxygenates blood outside the body and can buy time in selected arrests with a reversible cause. A balloon pump, or IABP, sits in the aorta and inflates between beats, and an Impella pumps blood from the left ventricle into the aorta. At home, you'll meet the LVAD, a left ventricular assist device. Its flow is continuous, so a well patient may have no pulse and no cuff pressure. Listen for the hum and call the device's twenty-four-hour line. No hum, no MAP and no signs of circulation means compressions.
slides.sayZh: 越来越多病人靠机器推动血液。ECLS，即体外生命支持，在体外给血液氧合，在部分有可逆病因的心脏骤停中能争取时间。球囊泵，即 IABP，放在主动脉里，在两次心跳之间充气；Impella 把血从左心室泵进主动脉。在家里你会遇到的是 LVAD，即左心室辅助装置。它是持续血流，所以状况良好的病人也可能摸不到脉搏、袖带测不出血压。听有没有嗡嗡声，并打装置的二十四小时热线。没有嗡嗡声、没有平均动脉压、也没有循环迹象，就开始按压。

slides.title: The patient's heart medicines
slides.body:
MedicineWatch for
NitroglycerinPotent = headache, bitter taste
Beta blockers (-lol)Slow HR; blunt epinephrine's beta effects
Calcium channel blockersLow BP; some slow the AV node
Digoxin + diureticLow K⁺ → toxicity: nausea, yellow vision, arrhythmias
-pril, -sartanDizzy on standing: BP lying and sitting
Blood thinnersBleeding, even from an IV site
slides.say: Your patients' medicines tell a story, but read them with the history, because one drug can have many uses. If someone took nitroglycerin, ask how much and whether it helped; fresh nitro usually brings a throbbing headache and a bitter taste. Beta blockers end in L-O-L; they slow the heart and can blunt epinephrine's beta effects. Calcium channel blockers can drop the pressure. Digoxin toxicity causes nausea, yellow vision and almost any arrhythmia, especially when a diuretic has lowered the potassium. Pills ending in pril or sartan can cause dizziness on standing. And blood thinners mean bleeding, even from your IV site.
slides.sayZh: 病人的药能说明很多问题，但要结合病史来看，因为一种药可能有多种用途。病人用过硝酸甘油，要问用了多少、有没有缓解；新鲜有效的硝酸甘油通常会带来搏动性头痛和苦味。β 阻滞剂的名字以 lol 结尾，会减慢心率，还会削弱肾上腺素的 β 作用。钙通道阻滞剂会让血压下降。地高辛中毒会引起恶心、黄视和几乎任何心律失常，尤其是利尿剂让血钾降低时。名字以 pril 或 sartan 结尾的降压药会引起站起来时头晕。抗凝药意味着容易出血，连你的静脉穿刺点都会。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• No gear is worth a long pause: back on the chest in under 5 s
  • Overventilation lowers output, during CPR and after ROSC
  • No muscle twitch after a shock? Check that sync is off
  • Pacing: feel for a pulse with every paced beat
  • A fast heart in heart failure may be compensating
  • Moving CPR is weaker CPR: move only for BC's reasons
slides.say: Here's what's new to watch out for beside an ALS partner. First, no equipment is worth a long pause; hands go back on the chest in under five seconds. Second, overventilation lowers cardiac output, during CPR and after ROSC. Third, if a shock fires and you see no muscle twitch, the book says check that the synchronize switch is off and the battery is charged. Fourth, during pacing you may be asked to feel for a pulse with every paced beat; that's called mechanical capture. Fifth, a fast heart in heart failure may be compensating, and slowing it can be fatal. And moving CPR is weaker CPR.
slides.sayZh: 在 ALS 搭档身边工作，有几件新的事要注意。第一，任何设备都不值得长时间中断，双手五秒内回到胸口。第二，过度通气会降低心输出量，心肺复苏时和自主循环恢复后都一样。第三，电击后看不到肌肉抽动，书里说要查同步开关是否已关、电池有没有电。第四，起搏时你可能被要求每个起搏心搏都摸一次脉搏，这叫机械夺获。第五，心衰病人心跳快可能是在代偿，强行减慢可能致命。还有，边移动边按压，按压质量会变差。

slides.title: For the BC exam
slides.body:
• Adults: 30:2, one or two rescuers (book: continuous option)
  • Pauses under 5 s (book: 10 s or less)
  • Stop at 30 / 40 minutes per BC (book: ALS rule after 15–20 min)
  • Epinephrine: IM only; no IO in EMR/PCP scope
  • Not in scope: atropine, benzos, opioids, needle decompression

Amiodarone, lidocaine, adenosine and dopamine aren't on BC's 18-drug list.
slides.say: For the BC exam, here's where the book and BC part ways. The book allows continuous compressions with two rescuers; BC uses thirty to two for adults. The book accepts pauses of ten seconds or less; BC wants under five. The book's advanced stopping rule comes after fifteen to twenty minutes of advanced care; BC uses its thirty and forty minute time points. Epinephrine in BC is intramuscular only, and intraosseous access isn't in EMR or PCP scope. Neither are atropine, benzodiazepines like midazolam, opioid pain medicines, or needle decompression. And amiodarone, lidocaine, adenosine and dopamine aren't on BC's eighteen-drug list.
slides.sayZh: BC 考试要注意书和 BC 不一样的地方。书里双人施救允许持续按压；BC 成人用三十比二。书里中断可以在十秒以内；BC 要求少于五秒。书里的高级生命支持停止规则在高级处置十五到二十分钟后；BC 用三十分钟和四十分钟时间点。BC 的肾上腺素只能肌注，骨髓腔通路不在 EMR 或 PCP 范围内。阿托品、咪达唑仑这类苯二氮卓药、阿片类镇痛药和针刺减压也都不在范围内。胺碘酮、利多卡因、腺苷和多巴胺不在 BC 的十八种考纲药物里。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Good CPR + early AED: 30:2, 100–120, 5–6 cm, pauses under 5 s
  2. BC arrest care is identical for EMR and PCP, except the PCP's SGA
  3. Time points: 30 min (no ROSC, no shock) or 40 min; consult oversight

Next: Chapter 31, Neurologic Emergencies
slides.say: Three things to remember. One: high-quality CPR and early defibrillation save lives. In BC, that's thirty to two, one hundred to one hundred twenty a minute, five to six centimetres deep, and pauses under five seconds. Two: BC arrest care is the same for EMRs and PCPs, except that PCPs may insert a supraglottic airway once high-quality CPR is under way. Three: the time points are thirty minutes with no ROSC and no shock, or forty after any ROSC or shock, and you consult medical oversight to stop on scene. That completes Chapter thirty. Next: neurologic emergencies. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 记住三件事。一，高质量心肺复苏和尽早除颤救命。在 BC 就是三十比二，每分钟一百到一百二十次，深五到六厘米，中断少于五秒。二，BC 的心脏骤停处置对 EMR 和 PCP 一样，只是 PCP 可以在高质量心肺复苏开始后置入声门上气道。三，时间点是：没有自主循环恢复、也没电击过，三十分钟；有过任何自主循环恢复或电击，四十分钟；要在现场停止须咨询医疗监督。第三十章到此结束。下一章：神经系统急症。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
